name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: 2 tankers hit off Khasab 21 Nov; strikes go on
summary: UKMTO says two tankers were hit off Oman's Khasab on 21 Nov; the US struck Qeshm and Iran fired at Kuwait in the week
state: UKMTO reported two tankers hit by unidentified projectiles 11 and 17 nautical miles from Khasab in the Strait of Hormuz on 21 Nov, with no casualties reported; Iran's navy said a tanker hit a mine in a restricted area (Jerusalem Post, citing Reuters). CBS News reported that the US struck Iran's Qeshm Island on 17 Nov and Iran launched strikes against Kuwait, and that the US and Israel are weighing a new assault. Talks via Qatar continue without a ceasefire. Active strikes and attacks on shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: Shipping, insurance and oil supply through Hormuz stay disrupted. Seafarers can follow UKMTO advisories, and anyone in the Gulf can follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Alert: active US–Iran strikes and attacks on shipping in Hormuz (UKMTO, 21 Nov)

sources.title: Jerusalem Post — Two tankers attacked in Strait of Hormuz near Oman, UKMTO says
CBS News — U.S. and Israel considering new assault on Iran, sources say

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
